audit.why: FAVOURED 4/10 fits: TF has no escape or duel tool at melee, his value is Destiny roams and late picks — the prose says exactly this. Chart (Pantheon 7/7) matches win[] and the kit; TF never beats Pantheon head-on at any stage.

Spikes present: level 2-3 all-in, 6 (Starfall lane spike vs his global-only Destiny), first-item solo-kill, his late pick/vision scaling. suspectNames flags 'Gold Card' in spikes[1] as a near-miss of Wild Cards — checked the kit: Gold Card is the stun card of Pick a Card and the sentence reads correctly. FALSE POSITIVE, no change.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digits and zero sequencing cues on the page; the Gate-channel interrupt (his R teleport takes 1.5s and dies to your W stun) was never stated.
audit.why: Pick a Card is a 6s cooldown, Destiny 170/140/110 with a 1.5s Gate channel — both from the kit. Bleed bullets replaced with distinct kit-grounded text (Aegis blocks his frontal card/Wild Cards/Stacked Deck burst).

edits.before: - Twisted Fate Pick a Card (Gold): matchup-defining — The locked gold card starts every trade and gank — back off the moment it glows yellow. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget E Aegis Assault for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - TF W (Pick a Card): 6s cooldown, but the lock is the tell — back off when it glows yellow, step in the moment the card is thrown. - His R Destiny is 170s at rank 1: the 1.5s Gate channel dies to your W stun if he ports near you. - Save E for the gold-card trade, not for Wild Cards poke.

edits.before: W the step-up, empowered-Q the stun, E the answer, walk — the full toll he paid for one last-hit.
edits.after: Aegis faces the burst: gold-card auto, Wild Cards, Stacked Deck proc — all frontal, all blocked.

edits.before: Spending the all-in into a held escape at even HP — Pantheon trades are loans; defaulting on one funds his whole comeback.
edits.after: When Aegis ends with him alive, a held Gold Card stuns you in his tower's arms — plan the exit before the dive.

notes: suspectNames 'Gold Card' is a false positive — it is Pick a Card's stun card and the spikes[1] sentence is correct as written. Chart, win[] and win rate agree; no chart edits.
